about: What each evidence track can deliver, and how sure each deliverable is. Source of truth for the README table under 'What you can do with only drawings, only process knowledge, or both', inside the README's 'Data first' section (python scripts/deliverables_matrix.py --write regenerates it; scripts/test_open100_structural.py checks they match and that every evidence path exists). Per-element confidence: python scripts/pipeline.py confidence.

tracks.te: Tennessee Eastman: process knowledge (a model transcribed from the published process and checked against the simulator source, recorded simulator replay); no original P&ID, only one generated from the model
tracks.open100: OPEN100: 12 real P&IDs, extracted and scored, no process data

statuses.done: built and checked; the note says how far
statuses.done_offline: built and rendered offline; not imported into a gateway
statuses.partial: built for part of the plant; the note says how much
statuses.draft: draft stills or text, not reviewed
statuses.mockup: design mockup, not a procedure or a verified result
statuses.synthetic_demo: works end to end on synthetic inputs only
statuses.not_possible: cannot be done with this track's inputs; the note says what is missing
statuses.not_applicable: the question does not arise for this track

te.note: transcribed from the published process; every tag checked against the simulator source (36 confirmed, 1 corrected) and every unit, stream, direction and tag owner against its balances and flow lines (51 confirmed, 4 corrected, 1 unresolvable of 56); 0 items reviewed by operations

open100.note: extracted from the drawings: 2,886 items, all unverified until reviewed, risk tiers 1,833 green / 676 amber / 377 red; on six held-out drawings (which also chose the method) symbols found F1 0.93, connections 0.87, review load 20.1 per 100, all means of five round-5 runs (the earlier single round-2 run scored 17.8)

te.note: a round trip on the generated sheets: every tag read on clean sheets by both models, 14% (GPT) and 49% (Claude) at the worst scan level; an upper bound for clean house-style drawings, not real-plant accuracy

open100.note: the public answer keys carry no text, so tag reading cannot be scored here; on three DEXPI example sheets with labelled symbols (round 5) GPT read 29 of 33 tags exactly and Claude 28, and on two more both found 99-100% of 145 identifiers from the published tag lists
